name: single-stranded DNA binding

name: obsolete ligand-regulated transcription factor activity

name: nuclear steroid receptor activity
definition: A nuclear receptor activity regulated by steroid binding and modulating the transcription of specific gene sets transcribed by RNA polymerase II.

name: obsolete RNA polymerase III transcription factor activity
synonyms: RNA polymerase III transcription factor activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Functions to initiate or regulate RNA polymerase III transcription.

name: transcription elongation factor activity
definition: A molecular function that stimulates the elongation properties of the RNA polymerase during the elongation phase of transcription. A subclass of transcription elongation factors enable the transition from transcription initiation to elongation, while another class rescue stalled RNA polymerases.

name: transcription coregulator activity
synonyms: RNA polymerase II transcriptional cofactor activity
definition: A transcription regulator activity that modulates the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Coregulators often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription coregulators modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators.

name: transcription coactivator activity
synonyms: RNA polymerase II transcription co-activator activity
RNA polymerase II transcription coactivator activity
RNA polymerase II transcription mediator activity
definition: A transcription coregulator activity that activates or increases the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Coactivators often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription coactivators modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators. A fourth class of coactivator activity is the bridging of a DNA-binding transcription factor to the general (basal) transcription machinery. The Mediator complex, which bridges sequence-specific DNA binding transcription factors and RNA polymerase, is also a transcription coactivator.

name: transcription corepressor activity
synonyms: RNA polymerase II transcription co-repressor activity
RNA polymerase II transcription corepressor activity
definition: A transcription coregulator activity that represses or decreases the transcription of specific gene sets via binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor at a specific genomic locus, either on its own or as part of a complex. Corepressors often act by altering chromatin structure and modifications. For example, one class of transcription corepressors modifies chromatin structure through covalent modification of histones. A second class remodels the conformation of chromatin in an ATP-dependent fashion. A third class modulates interactions of DNA-bound DNA-binding transcription factors with other transcription coregulators.

name: obsolete transcription termination factor activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Any activity that brings about termination of transcription.

name: obsolete RNA polymerase I transcription termination factor activity

definition: OBSOLETE. Any activity that brings about termination of transcription by RNA polymerase I.

name: obsolete RNA polymerase II transcription termination factor activity

RNA polymerase II transcription termination factor activity

RNA polymerase III transcription termination factor activity

name: obsolete telomerase RNA reverse transcriptase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the extension of the 3' end of a DNA strand by one deoxynucleotide at a time. Cannot initiate a chain de novo; uses the RNA subunit of the telomerase enzyme complex as its template.

name: RNA binding
definition: Binding to an RNA molecule or a portion thereof.

name: RNA helicase activity
definition: Unwinding of an RNA helix, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: double-stranded RNA binding

name: double-stranded RNA adenosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine + H2O = inosine + NH3, in a double-stranded RNA molecule.

name: single-stranded RNA binding

name: mRNA binding
definition: Binding to messenger RNA (mRNA), an intermediate molecule between DNA and protein. mRNA includes UTR and coding sequences, but does not contain introns.

name: mRNA 3'-UTR binding

name: obsolete mRNA cap binding

name: obsolete snRNA cap binding

name: translation initiation factor activity

name: translation elongation factor activity
definition: Functions in chain elongation during polypeptide synthesis at the ribosome.

name: translation release factor activity
definition: Involved in catalyzing the release of a nascent polypeptide chain from a ribosome.

name: obsolete cell cycle regulator

name: peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-proline (omega=180) = peptidyl-proline (omega=0).

name: protein disulfide isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the rearrangement of both intrachain and interchain disulfide bonds in proteins.

name: obsolete glycoprotein-specific chaperone activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Assists in the correct, non-covalent assembly of glycoproteins in vivo, but is not a component of the assembled structures when performing its normal biological function. Utilizes a lectin site as a means to associate with the unfolded glycoproteins.

name: obsolete histone-specific chaperone activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Assists in chromatin assembly by chaperoning histones on to replicating DNA, but is not a component of the assembled nucleosome when performing its normal biological function.

name: obsolete chaperonin ATPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate. The hydrolysis of ATP involved in maintaining an unfolded polypeptide structure before folding or to entry into mitochondria and chloroplasts.

name: obsolete co-chaperone activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Co-chaperones are proteins that bind to chaperones and this complex then folds misfolded proteins. Co-chaperones by themselves do not possess chaperone activity.

name: obsolete co-chaperonin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Co-chaperonins are proteins that bind to chaperones and this complex then folds misfolded proteins. Co-chaperonins by themselves do not possess chaperone activity.

name: obsolete heat shock protein activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Any of a group of specific proteins that are synthesized by both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells after they have been exposed to a temperature that is higher than normal. Other stresses, e.g. free radical damage, have a similar effect. Many members of the hsp family are not induced but are present in all cells. They are characterized by their role as molecular chaperones.

name: cytoskeletal motor activity
definition: Generation of force resulting in movement, for example along a microfilament or microtubule, or in torque resulting in membrane scission or rotation of a flagellum. The energy required is obtained either from the hydrolysis of a nucleoside triphosphate or by an electrochemical proton gradient (proton-motive force).

definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the selective cleavage of the Arg-Ile bond in factor X to form factor Xa.

name: obsolete coagulation factor XIIa activity

name: obsolete plasma kallikrein activity

name: obsolete protein C (activated) activity
synonyms: activated blood coagulation factor XIV activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the degradation of blood coagulation factors Va and VIIIa.

name: obsolete thrombin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Arg-Gly; activates fibrinogen to fibrin and releases fibrinopeptide A and B.

name: protein-glutamine gamma-glutamyltransferase activity

name: obsolete complement component C1s activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of component C4 to C4a and C4b (Arg-Ala bond), and component C2 to C2a and C2b (Lys-Lys or Arg-Lys bond).

Binding may counteract the biological activity of the antigen. Antigen binding by an MHC protein complex allows the antigen to be displayed to a T cell or NK cell.

name: catalytic activity
definition: Catalysis of a biochemical reaction at physiological temperatures. In biologically catalyzed reactions, the reactants are known as substrates, and the catalysts are naturally occurring macromolecular substances known as enzymes. Enzymes possess specific binding sites for substrates, and are usually composed wholly or largely of protein, but RNA that has catalytic activity (ribozyme) is often also regarded as enzymatic.

name: beta-1,3-galactosyl-O-glycosyl-glycoprotein beta-1,6-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R = UDP + beta-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-[N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1->6)]-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-R. name: beta-alanyl-dopamine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-alanyl-dopamine + H2O = dopamine + beta-alanine.

name: beta-alanyl amine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the synthesis of beta-alanyl amine conjugate from a precursor biogenic amine, such as dopamine or histamine.

definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: an 11-beta-hydroxysteroid + NAD(P)+ = an 11-oxosteroid + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: short-chain 2-methyl fatty acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity

name: 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta5-steroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity

name: 3-dehydroquinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonate = 3-dehydroquinate + phosphate.

definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose-6-phosphate = ADP + D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + ATP = beta-D-fructose 2,6-bisphosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate = 6-pyruvoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin + H+ + triphosphate.

name: ADP-ribosylarginine hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: H2O + N(omega)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginyl-[protein] = ADP-D-ribose + L-arginyl-[protein], and H2O + N(omega)-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginine = ADP-D-ribose + L-arginine.

name: AMP deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + H2O = IMP + NH3.

name: ATP:ADP adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ADP + ATP = phosphate + P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-adenosyl)tetraphosphate.

name: ATP citrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + ADP + H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate = ATP + citrate + CoA.

name: ATP phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP + diphosphate = ATP + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: protein C-terminal carboxyl O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a methyl group to the oxygen atom of a carboxyl group at the C-terminal of a protein.

name: CDP-diacylglycerol-inositol 3-phosphatidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol + CDP-diacylglycerol = 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + CMP + H+.

name: CDP-diacylglycerol-serine O-phosphatidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-diacylglycerol + L-serine = CMP + O-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine.

name: CTP synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + UTP + glutamine + H20= ADP + phosphate + CTP + glutamate.

name: D-amino-acid oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a D-alpha-amino acid + H2O + O2 = a 2-oxocarboxylate + H2O2 + NH4+.

name: D-arabinono-1,4-lactone oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-arabinono-1,4-lactone + O2 = dehydro-D-arabinono-1,4-lactone + H2O2 + H+.

name: DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5-methyl-2'-deoxycytidine in DNA + H+ + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deoxynucleoside triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); DNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

name: obsolete proliferating cell nuclear antigen
definition: OBSOLETE. A nuclear protein that associates as a trimer and then interacts with delta DNA polymerase and epsilon DNA polymerase, acting as an auxiliary factor for DNA replication and DNA repair.

name: obsolete DNA primase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the synthesis of a short RNA primer on a DNA template, providing a free 3'-OH that can be extended by DNA-directed DNA polymerases. In certain conditions, for example in response to DNA damage, some primases synthesize a DNA primer.

name: DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
synonyms: deoxyribonucleic acid-dependent ribonucleic acid polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1). Utilizes a DNA template, i.e. the catalysis of DNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time. Can initiate a chain 'de novo'.

name: obsolete DNA-directed RNA polymerase I activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1).

name: obsolete DNA-directed RNA polymerase II activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1).

name: obsolete DNA-directed RNA polymerase III activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1).

name: deoxyribodipyrimidine photo-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cyclobutadipyrimidine (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). This reaction represents the reactivation of irradiated DNA by light.

name: alkylbase DNA N-glycosylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA with alkylated base + H2O = DNA with abasic site + alkylated base. This reaction is the hydrolysis of DNA by cleavage of the N-C1' glycosidic bond between the target damaged DNA base and the deoxyribose sugar to remove an alkylated base, leaving an apyrimidinic or apurinic site.

name: DNA-(apurinic or apyrimidinic site) endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of the C-O-P bond in the AP site created when DNA glycosylase removes a damaged base, involved in the DNA base excision repair pathway (BER).

name: methylated-DNA-[protein]-cysteine S-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: DNA (containing 6-O-methylguanine) + (protein)-L-cysteine = DNA (without 6-O-methylguanine) + protein S-methyl-L-cysteine.

name: DNA ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of a phosphodiester bond between the 3'-hydroxyl group at the end of one DNA chain and the 5'-phosphate group at the end of another. This reaction requires an energy source such as ATP or NAD+.

name: DNA ligase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + deoxyribonucleotide(n) + deoxyribonucleotide(m) = AMP + diphosphate + deoxyribonucleotide(n+m).

name: DNA ligase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + deoxyribonucleotide(n) + deoxyribonucleotide(m) = AMP + nicotinamide nucleotide + deoxyribonucleotide(n+m).

name: DNA nucleotidylexotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deoxynucleoside triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); template-independent extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

name: DNA photolyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the repair of a photoproduct resulting from ultraviolet irradiation of two adjacent pyrimidine residues in DNA.

name: DNA (6-4) photolyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyrimidine-pyrimidone (6-4) photoproduct (in DNA) = 2 pyrimidine residues (in DNA). Catalyzes the reactivation of ultraviolet-irradiated DNA.

name: DNA topoisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transient cleavage and passage of individual DNA strands or double helices through one another, resulting a topological transformation in double-stranded DNA.

name: DNA topoisomerase type I (single strand cut, ATP-independent) activity
definition: Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving one DNA strand at a time to allow passage of another strand; changes the linking number by +1 per catalytic cycle.

name: DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of a DNA topological transformation by transiently cleaving a pair of complementary DNA strands to form a gate through which a second double-stranded DNA segment is passed, after which the severed strands in the first DNA segment are rejoined, driven by ATP hydrolysis. The enzyme changes the linking number in multiples of 2.

name: FMN adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + FMN = diphosphate + FAD.

name: GMP reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: IMP + NADP+ + NH4 = GMP + 2 H+ + NADPH.

name: GMP synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + NH4(+) = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + 2H+.

name: GMP synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + XMP + L-glutamine + H2O = AMP + diphosphate + GMP + L-glutamate + 2H+.

name: GPI-anchor transamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the formation of the linkage between a protein and a glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor. The reaction probably occurs by subjecting a peptide bond to nucleophilic attack by the amino group of ethanolamine-GPI, transferring the protein from a signal peptide to the GPI anchor.

name: GTPase activity
synonyms: hydrolase activity, acting on acid anhydrides, acting on GTP, involved in cellular and subcellular movement
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + H+ + phosphate.

name: G protein activity
definition: A molecular function regulator that cycles between active GTP-bound and inactive GDP-bound states. In its active state, binds to a variety of effector proteins to regulate cellular processes. Intrinsic GTPase activity returns the G protein to its GDP-bound state. The return to the GDP-bound state can be accelerated by the action of a GTPase-activating protein (GAP).

name: obsolete ARF small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate.

name: obsolete RAB small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate.

name: obsolete RAN small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate.

name: obsolete RAS small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate.

name: obsolete Rho small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate. Any member of the Rho subfamily of the RAS superfamily of monomeric GTPases. Proteins in the Rho subfamily are involved in relaying signals from cell-surface receptors to the actin cytoskeleton.

name: obsolete SAR small monomeric GTPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = GDP + phosphate.

name: GTP cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the imidazole ring of GTP, releasing formate. Two C-N bonds are hydrolyzed and the pentase unit is isomerized.

name: GTP cyclohydrolase I activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + H2O = 7,8-dihydroneopterin 3'-triphosphate + formate + H+.

name: GTP cyclohydrolase II activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + 4 H2O = 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine + formate + 3 H+ + 2 phosphate.

name: obsolete hydrogen-transporting two-sector ATPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O + H+(in) = ADP + phosphate + H+(out).

name: IMP cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: IMP + H2O = 5-formamido-1-(5-phosphoribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: IMP dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: inosine 5'-phosphate + NAD+ + H2O = xanthosine 5'-phosphate + NADH + H+.

name: L-iditol 2-dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-iditol + NAD+ = L-sorbose + NADH + H+. Acts on a number of sugar alcohols, including (but not limited to) L-iditol, D-glucitol, D-xylitol, and D-galactitol.

name: L-iduronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-L-iduronosidic linkages in dermatan sulfate. Can also hydrolyze alpha-L-iduronosidic linkages in heparan sulfate.

name: L-serine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine = pyruvate + NH3.

name: N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = N-acetyl-5-glutamyl phosphate + NADPH + H+.

name: N-acetylgalactosamine-4-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 4-sulfate groups of the N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate units of chondroitin sulfate and dermatan sulfate.

name: N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphodiester alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycoprotein N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-phospho-D-mannose + H2O = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + glycoprotein phospho-D-mannose.

name: N-acetyllactosamine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP + N-acetyllactosamine.

name: (N-acetylneuraminyl)-galactosylglucosylceramide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine + (N-acetylneuraminyl)-D-galactosyl-D-glucosylceramide = UDP + N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-(N-acetylneuraminyl)-D-galactosyl-D-glucosylceramide.

name: N4-(beta-N-acetylglucosaminyl)-L-asparaginase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(4)-(beta-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-asparagine + H2O = N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminylamine + L-aspartate + H+.

name: 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide = 5-[(5-phospho-1-deoxy-D-ribulos-1-ylimino)methylamino]-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: NAD+ poly-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + (ADP-D-ribosyl)(n)-acceptor = nicotinamide + (ADP-D-ribosyl)(n+1)-acceptor.

name: NAD+ kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + NAD+ = ADP + H+ + NADP+.

name: NAD+ synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: deamido-NAD+ + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = L-glutamate + AMP + diphosphate + NAD+ + H+.

name: NAD+ nucleosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD+ + H2O = ADP-D-ribose + nicotinamide + H+.

name: NADH dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADH + H+ + acceptor = NAD+ + reduced acceptor.

name: NAD(P)H dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
synonyms: viologen accepting pyridine nucleotide oxidoreductase activity
dehydrogenase, reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (phosphate, quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)H + H+ + a quinone = NAD(P)+ + a quinol.

name: NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase (Si-specific) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + NAD+ = NADP+ + NADH.

name: NADPH-hemoprotein reductase activity
synonyms: cytochrome c reductase (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate, NADPH, NADPH-dependent) activity
dihydroxynicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate-cytochrome c reductase activity
reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate-cytochrome c reductase activity
reductase, cytochrome c (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + n oxidized hemoprotein = NADP+ + n reduced hemoprotein.

name: NADPH dehydrogenase activity
synonyms: dihydronicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate dehydrogenase activity
reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADPH + H+ + acceptor = NADP+ + reduced acceptor.

name: quinone reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 a quinone + NADPH + H+ = 2 a 1,4-benzosemiquinone + NADP+.

name: O-acetylhomoserine aminocarboxypropyltransferase activity
synonyms: L-methionine biosynthetic process, direct, from O-acetyl-L-homoserine
methionine biosynthetic process, direct, from O-acetyl-L-homoserine
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-acetyl-L-homoserine + methanethiol = L-methionine + acetate. Also reacts with other thiols and H2S, producing homocysteine or thioethers.

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + O-succinyl-L-homoserine = H+ + L,L-cystathionine + succinate.

name: RNA-3'-phosphate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + RNA 3'-terminal-phosphate = AMP + diphosphate + RNA terminal-2',3'-cyclic-phosphate.

name: RNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
synonyms: RNA-directed DNA polymerase, group II intron encoded
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + DNA(n) = diphosphate + DNA(n+1); RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of a DNA strand by one deoxynucleotide at a time.

name: obsolete RNA-directed DNA polymerase, transposon encoded
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'- end of a DNA strand by one deoxynucleotide at a time; cannot initiate a chain de novo.

name: obsolete RNA-directed DNA polymerase, group II intron encoded
synonyms: RNA-directed DNA polymerase, group II intron encoded
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'- end of a DNA strand by one deoxynucleotide at a time; cannot initiate a chain de novo.

name: RNA-directed RNA polymerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside triphosphate + RNA(n) = diphosphate + RNA(n+1); uses an RNA template, i.e. the catalysis of RNA-template-directed extension of the 3'-end of an RNA strand by one nucleotide at a time.

name: obsolete RNA editase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: RNA ligase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + (ribonucleotide)n-3'-hydroxyl + 5'-phospho-(ribonucleotide)m = (ribonucleotide)n+m + AMP + diphosphate.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-acid oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-2-hydroxy-acid + O2 = 2-oxo acid + hydrogen peroxide.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine = UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-dolichyl-phosphate N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + dolichyl phosphate = UMP + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-diphosphodolichol.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine-lysosomal-enzyme N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + lysosomal-enzyme D-mannose = UMP + lysosomal-enzyme N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-phospho-D-mannose.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP = diphosphate + UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine.

name: UDP-glucose 4-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose = UDP-galactose.

name: UDP-glucose 6-dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 2 NAD+ + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = 3 H+ + 2 NADH + UDP-alpha-D-glucuronate.

name: UDP-glucose:glycoprotein glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the addition of UDP-glucose on to asparagine-linked (N-linked) oligosaccharides of the form Man7-9GlcNAc2 on incorrectly folded glycoproteins.

name: UTP:glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + UTP = diphosphate + UDP-D-glucose.

name: acetolactate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + 2 pyruvate = (2S)-2-acetolactate + CO2. Can also convert 2-oxobutanoate and pyruvate to (S)-2-ethyl-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutanoate.

name: acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 acetyl-CoA = CoA + acetoacetyl-CoA.

name: acetyl-CoA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + H2O = acetate + CoA + H+.

name: acetate-CoA ligase activity
synonyms: short chain fatty acyl-CoA synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetate + CoA = AMP + diphosphate + acetyl-CoA.

name: acetyl-CoA C-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA = CoA + 3-oxoacyl-CoA.

name: acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + acetyl-CoA + HCO3- = ADP + phosphate + malonyl-CoA.

name: acetylcholinesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetylcholine + H2O = choline + acetate.

name: acetylglutamate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate = ADP + N-acetyl-L-glutamate-5-phosphate.

name: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine:2-oxoglutarate 5-aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine = N-acetyl-L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + L-glutamate.

name: acid phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an orthophosphoric monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an acid pH optimum.

name: aconitate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: citrate = isocitrate. The reaction occurs in two steps: (1) citrate = cis-aconitate + H2O, (2) cis-aconitate + H2O = isocitrate. This reaction is the interconversion of citrate and isocitrate via the labile, enzyme-bound intermediate cis-aconitate. Water is removed from one part of the citrate molecule and added back to a different atom to form isocitrate.

name: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
synonyms: fatty acyl coenzyme A dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + H+ oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: acyl-CoA oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-CoA + O2 = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O2.

name: acylphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl phosphate + H2O = a carboxylate + phosphate.

name: adenine phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AMP + diphosphate = adenine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: adenosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine + H2O = inosine + NH3.

name: adenosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + adenosine = ADP + AMP.

name: obsolete plasma membrane cation-transporting ATPase
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete heavy metal-exporting ATPase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: heavy metal ion(in) + ATP + H2O = heavy metal ion(out) + ADP + phosphate.

name: obsolete ATP-binding cassette (ABC) transporter activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: adenosylhomocysteinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H2O = adenosine + L-homocysteine.

name: adenosylmethionine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + H+ = S-adenosylmethioninamine + CO2.

name: adenosylmethionine-8-amino-7-oxononanoate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 8-amino-7-oxononanoate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine(1+) = 7,8-diaminononanoate + S-adenosyl-4-methylthio-2-oxobutanoate.

name: adenylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate.

name: AMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + AMP = 2 ADP.

name: N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)AMP AMP-lyase (fumarate-forming) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)AMP = fumarate + AMP.

name: adenylosuccinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + GTP + IMP = N(6)-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)-AMP + GDP + 3 H+ + phosphate.

name: adenylylsulfate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + ATP = 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate + ADP + H+.

name: L-alanine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + L-alanine = L-glutamate + pyruvate.

name: alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+.

name: obsolete alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity, metal ion-independent
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+; can proceed in the absence of a metal ion.

name: obsolete alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity, zinc-dependent
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+, requiring the presence of zinc.

name: obsolete alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity, iron-dependent
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+, requiring the presence of iron.

name: alcohol O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an alcohol = CoA + an acetyl ester.

name: alcohol sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + an alcohol = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + an alkyl sulfate.

name: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-chloroallyl aldehyde + H2O = 2 H+ + 2 e- + 3-chloroacrylic acid.

name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + H2O + NAD+ = a carboxylate + 2 H+ + NADH.

name: aldehyde dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + NAD(P)+ + H2O = an acid + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: aldehyde oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an aldehyde + H2O + O2 = a carboxylic acid + hydrogen peroxide.

name: aldose reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alditol + NADP+ = an aldose + NADPH + H+.

name: obsolete aldo-keto reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NADP+ = an aldehyde or a ketone + NADPH + H+.

name: aldose 1-epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose = beta-D-glucose. Also acts on L-arabinose, D-xylose, D-galactose, maltose and lactose.

name: alkaline phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphate monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an alkaline pH optimum.

name: allantoicase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: allantoate + H2O = (S)-ureidoglycolate + urea.

name: allantoinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: allantoin + H2O = allantoate.

name: allophanate hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 3 H+ + urea-1-carboxylate = 2 CO2 + 2 NH4.

name: amidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a monocarboxylic acid amide + H2O = a monocarboxylate + NH4+.

name: L-glutamate N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H+.

name: L-aminoadipate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
synonyms: L-alpha-aminoadipate delta-semialdehyde:nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-2-aminoadipate 6-semialdehyde + NADP+ + H2O = L-2-aminoadipate + NADPH + H+.

name: amidophosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-phospho-beta-D-ribosylamine + L-glutamate + diphosphate = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + L-glutamine + H2O.

name: peptidyl-tRNA hydrolase activity
synonyms: N-substituted aminoacyl transfer RNA hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-L-alpha-aminoacyl-tRNA + H2O = an N-acyl-L-amino acid + a tRNA + H+.

name: aminoacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-acyl-L-amino acid + H2O = a carboxylate + an L-amino acid.

name: aminomethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-aminomethyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate = N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + (6R)-5,10-methylene-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NH4+.

name: anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate + diphosphate = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + anthranilate.

name: anthranilate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate + L-glutamine = anthranilate + pyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: apyrase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate + 2 H2O = a ribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + 2 phosphate. This reaction consists of two distinct successive phosphate-releasing steps, with NDPs as intermediates. Apyrases are active against both di- and triphosphate nucleotides (NDPs and NTPs) and hydrolyze NTPs to nucleotide monophosphates (NMPs).

name: arachidonate 5-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + O2 = H2O + leukotriene A4.

name: arachidonate 12(S)-lipoxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: arachidonate + O2 = (5Z,8Z,10E,12S,14Z)-12-hydroperoxyicosa-5,8,10,14-tetraenoate.

name: arginase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H2O = L-ornithine + urea.

name: arginine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + ATP = N(omega)-phospho-L-arginine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: argininosuccinate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-citrulline + L-aspartate = AMP + diphosphate + (N(omega)-L-arginino)succinate.

name: argininosuccinate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(L-arginino)succinate = fumarate + L-arginine.

name: arginyl-tRNA--protein transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N-terminal L-alpha-aminoacyl-[protein] + L-arginyl-tRNA(Arg) = H+ + N-terminal L-arginyl-L-amino acid-[protein] + tRNA(Arg).

name: aromatic-L-amino-acid decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-amino acid + H+ = R-H + CO2.

name: aralkylamine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an aralkylamine = CoA + an N-acetylaralkylamine.

name: arylamine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an arylamine = CoA + an N-acetylarylamine.

name: arylformamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-formyl-L-kynurenine + H2O = formate + L-kynurenine.

name: aryl sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + a phenol = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + an aryl sulfate.

name: aryldialkylphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: aryl dialkyl phosphate + H2O = dialkyl phosphate + an aryl alcohol.

name: arylesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phenyl acetate + H2O = a phenol + acetate.

name: arylsulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phenol sulfate + H2O = a phenol + sulfate.

name: asparagine synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-aspartate + L-glutamine = AMP + diphosphate + L-asparagine + L-glutamate.

name: asparaginase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-asparagine + H2O = L-aspartate + NH4+.

name: aspartate 1-decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate = beta-alanine + CO2.

name: L-aspartate:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + 2-oxoglutarate = oxaloacetate + L-glutamate.

name: aspartate carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + carbamoyl phosphate = N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate + H+ + phosphate.

name: aspartate-ammonia ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-aspartate + NH3 = AMP + diphosphate + L-asparagine.

name: aspartate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate + ATP = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + ADP + H+.

name: aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + H+ + NADPH.

name: biliverdin reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: bilirubin IXalpha + NAD(P)+ = biliverdin IXalpha + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: biotin carboxylase activity
synonyms: biotin carboxylase (component of acetyl CoA carboxylase) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + biotin-carboxyl-carrier protein + CO2 = ADP + phosphate + carboxybiotin-carboxyl-carrier protein.

name: biotin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin + [sulfur carrier]-SH + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = [sulfur carrier]-H + biotin + 2 5'-deoxyadenosine + 2 L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin].

name: biotin--[biotin carboxyl-carrier protein] ligase activity
synonyms: acetyl coenzyme A holocarboxylase synthetase activity
acetyl-CoA carboxylase biotin holoenzyme synthetase activity
biotin-acetyl coenzyme A carboxylase synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + biotin + L-lysyl-[protein] = AMP + diphosphate + H+ + N(6)-biotinyl-L-lysyl-[protein].

name: obsolete biotin-[methylcrotonoyl-CoA-carboxylase] ligase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + biotin + apo-(3-methylcrotonoyl-CoA:carbon-dioxide ligase (ADP-forming)) = AMP + diphosphate + (3-methylcrotonoyl-CoA:carbon-dioxide ligase (ADP-forming)).

name: obsolete biotin-[methylmalonyl-CoA-carboxytransferase] ligase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + biotin + apo-(methylmalonyl-CoA:pyruvate carboxytransferase) = AMP + diphosphate + (methylmalonyl-CoA:pyruvate carboxytransferase).

name: obsolete biotin-[propionyl-CoA-carboxylase (ATP-hydrolyzing)] ligase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + biotin + apo-(propanoyl-CoA:carbon-dioxide ligase (ADP-forming)) = AMP + diphosphate + (propanoyl-CoA:carbon-dioxide ligase (ADP-forming)).

name: bis(5'-nucleosyl)-tetraphosphatase (asymmetrical) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: P(1),P(4)-bis(5'-nucleosyl)tetraphosphate + H2O = NTP + NMP. Acts on bis(5'-guanosyl)-, bis(5'-xanthosyl)-, bis(5'-adenosyl)- and bis(5'-uridyl)-tetraphosphate.

name: bisphosphoglycerate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate = 2,3-bisphospho-D-glycerate.

name: obsolete bisphosphoglycerate 2-phosphatase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 2,3-bisphospho-D-glycerate + H2O = 3-phospho-D-glycerate + phosphate.

name: branched-chain-amino-acid transaminase activity
synonyms: L-branched chain amino acid aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a branched-chain amino acid (L-leucine, L-isoleucine and L-valine) + 2-oxoglutarate = L-glutamate + a 2-oxocarboxylate derived from the branched-chain amino acid.

name: obsolete butyryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: butanoyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: obsolete carbamoyl-phosphate synthase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of a reaction that results in the formation of carbamoyl phosphate.

name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase (ammonia) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ATP + hydrogencarbonate + NH4+ = 2 ADP + carbamoyl phosphate + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogencarbonate + L-glutamine + 2 ATP + H2O = carbamoyl phosphate + L-glutamate + 2 ADP + phosphate + 2 H+.

name: carbonate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: hydrogencarbonate + H+ = CO2 + H2O.

name: carbonyl reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a secondary alcohol + NADP+ = a ketone + H+ + NADPH.

name: carnitine O-acetyltransferase activity
synonyms: carnitine acetyl coenzyme A transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + carnitine = (R)-O-acetylcarnitine + CoA.

name: carnitine O-palmitoyltransferase activity
synonyms: CPT I (outer membrane carnitine palmitoyl transferase)
outer malonyl-CoA inhibitable carnitine palmitoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: palmitoyl-CoA + L-carnitine = CoA + L-palmitoylcarnitine.

name: catalase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 hydrogen peroxide = O2 + 2 H2O.

name: catechol oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 catechol + O2 = 2 1,2-benzoquinone + 2 H2O. This reaction catalyzes exclusively the oxidation of catechols (i.e., o-diphenols) to the corresponding o-quinones.

name: cerebroside-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a cerebroside 3-sulfate + H2O = a cerebroside + sulfate.

name: chitin deacetylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chitin + H2O = chitosan + acetate.

name: chitin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + [->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1-](n) = UDP + [->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-(1-](n+1).

name: choline O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + choline = acetylcholine + CoA.

name: choline kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + choline = ADP + choline phosphate + 2 H+.

name: cholinesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acylcholine + H2O = choline + a carboxylic acid anion.

name: choline-phosphate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + choline phosphate = diphosphate + CDP-choline.

name: chorismate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: chorismate = prephenate.

name: chorismate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate = chorismate + phosphate.

name: obsolete citrate (Si)-synthase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + H2O + oxaloacetate = citrate + CoA, where the acetyl group is added to the si-face of oxaloacetate; acetyl-CoA thus provides the two carbon atoms of the pro-S carboxymethyl group.

name: coproporphyrinogen oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: coproporphyrinogen III + 2 H+ + O2 = 2 CO2 + 2 H2O + protoporphyrinogen IX.

name: corticosteroid side-chain-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 11-deoxycorticosterone = 20-hydroxy-3-oxopregn-4-en-21-al.

name: creatine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + creatine = N-phosphocreatine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a nucleoside cyclic phosphate + H2O = a nucleoside phosphate.

name: 2',3'-cyclic-nucleotide 3'-phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside 2',3'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = nucleoside 2'-phosphate.

name: 3',5'-cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = a nucleoside 5'-phosphate.

name: 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+.

name: calmodulin-activated dual specificity 3',5'-cyclic-GMP, 3',5'-cyclic-AMP phosphodiesterase activity
synonyms: calmodulin-activated cyclic-nucleotide dual specificity phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: 3',5'-cyclic AMP + H2O = AMP + H+ and 3',5'-cyclic GMP + H2O = GMP + H+; this activity is activated by binding to calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: 3',5'-cGMP-stimulated cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = nucleoside 5'-phosphate; catalytic activity is increased in the presence of cGMP.

name: 3',5'-cGMP-inhibited cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside 3',5'-cyclic phosphate + H2O = nucleoside 5'-phosphate; catalytic activity is decreased in the presence of cGMP.

name: obsolete photoreceptor cyclic-nucleotide phosphodiesterase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: nucleoside cyclic phosphate + H2O = nucleoside phosphate. This reaction is the hydrolysis of bonds in a cyclic nucleotide.

name: obsolete cystathionine beta-lyase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: cystathionine + H2O = L-homocysteine + NH3 + pyruvate.

name: cystathionine beta-synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-serine + L-homocysteine = cystathionine + H2O.

name: cystathionine gamma-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cystathionine + H2O = 2-oxobutanoate + L-cysteine + NH4+.

name: cysteine synthase activity
synonyms: cysteine synthase activity, acting on O-acetyl-L-serine
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O3-acetyl-L-serine + hydrogen sulfide = L-cysteine + acetate.

name: L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) selenium transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) + selenophosphate = L-selenocysteinyl-tRNA(Sec) + H2O + phosphate.

name: cytidine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytidine + H+ + H2O = uridine + NH4 and deoxycytidine + H+ + H2O = deoxyuridine + NH4+.

name: obsolete (d)CMP kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + (d)CMP = ADP + (d)CDP.

name: cytochrome-b5 reductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome b5] + NAD(P)H = 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome b5] + NAD(P)+ + H+.

name: cytochrome-c oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + O2 + 8 H+(in) = 4 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + 2 H2O + 4 H+(out).

name: cytochrome-c peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 ferrocytochrome c + hydrogen peroxide = 2 ferricytochrome c + 2 H2O.

name: cytosine deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: cytosine + H2O = uracil + NH3.

name: dCMP deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dCMP + H2O = dUMP + NH3.

name: obsolete glycogen debranching enzyme activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of branch points in branched glycogen polymers.

name: 4-alpha-glucanotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a segment of a (1->4)-alpha-D-glucan to a new 4-position in an acceptor, which may be glucose or (1->4)-alpha-D-glucan.

name: amylo-alpha-1,6-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic branch linkages in glycogen phosphorylase limit dextrin. Limit dextrin is the highly branched core that remains after exhaustive treatment of glycogen with glycogen phosphorylase. It is formed because these enzymes cannot hydrolyze the (1->6) glycosidic linkages present.

name: deoxyadenosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyadenosine + ATP = ADP + dAMP + 2 H+.

name: deoxycytidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NTP + deoxycytidine = NDP + CMP.

name: deoxyguanosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2'-deoxyguanosine + ATP = ADP + dGMP + 2 H+.

name: deoxyribose-phosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-deoxy-D-ribose 5-phosphate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + acetaldehyde.

name: dephospho-CoA kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-dephospho-CoA + ATP = ADP + CoA + 2 H+.

name: dethiobiotin synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-diaminononanoate + ATP + CO2 = ADP + dethiobiotin + 4 H+ + phosphate.

name: diacylglycerol cholinephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-choline + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CMP + a phosphatidylcholine.

name: ATP-dependent diacylglycerol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + ATP = a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: diacylglycerol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-CoA + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CoA + triacylglycerol.

name: diamine N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alkane-alpha,omega-diamine + acetyl-CoA = an N-acetylalkane-alpha,omega-diamine + CoA + H+.

name: dihydrofolate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate + NADP+ = 7,8-dihydrofolate + NADPH + H+.

name: dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (NADH) activity
synonyms: E3 component of alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase complexes activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + NAD+ = N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + NADH + H+.

name: dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex component E2] + succinyl-CoA = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-succinyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex component E2] + CoA.

name: dihydroneopterin aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-(D-erythro-1,2,3-trihydroxypropyl)-7,8-dihydropteridine = 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-hydroxymethyl-7,8-dihydropteridine + glycolaldehyde.

name: dihydroorotase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + H2O = N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate + H+.

name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + A = AH(2) + orotate.

name: dihydropterin deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 7,8-dihydropterin + H2O = 7,8-dihydrolumazine + NH3.

name: dihydropterin oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 7,8-dihydropteridine compound + O2 = an oxidized 7,8-dihydropteridine compound + H2O2. Specific substrates and their fully oxidized products include: 7,8-dihydropteridin/pterin, 7,8-dihydrobiopterin/biopterin, 7,8-dihydroxanthopterin/xanthopterin and sepiapterin/oxidized sepiapterin.

name: 6,7-dihydropteridine reductase activity
synonyms: dihydropteridine (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NAD(P)+ + 5,6,7,8-tetrahydropteridine = NAD(P)H + H+ + 6,7-dihydropteridine.

name: dihydropteroate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-amino-4-hydroxy-6-hydroxymethyl-7,8-dihydropteridine diphosphate + 4-aminobenzoate = diphosphate + dihydropteroate.

name: dihydropyrimidinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,6-dihydrouracil + H2O = 3-ureidopropionate.

name: obsolete dihydroorotate oxidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + O2 = H2O2 + orotate.

name: dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5,6-dihydropyrimidine (5,6-dihydrouracil or 5,6-dihydrothymine) + NAD+ = a pyrimidine (uracil or thymine) + NADH + H+.

name: dihydroxy-acid dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate = 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + H2O.

name: dimethylallyltranstransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dimethylallyl diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (2E)-geranyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: obsolete dimethylnitrosamine demethylase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the removal of a methyl group from N-nitrosodimethylamine.

name: diphosphomevalonate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ATP = ADP + CO2 + H+ + isopentenyl diphosphate + phosphate.

name: diphthine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-[(3S)-amino-3-carboxypropyl]-L-histidyl-[translation elongation factor 2] + 3 S-adenosyl-L-methionine = diphthine-[translation elongation factor 2] + 3 H+ + 3 S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: delta(3)-delta(2)-enoyl-CoA isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: a (3Z)-enoyl-CoA = a 4-saturated (2E)-enoyl-CoA or a (3E)-enoyl-CoA = a 4-saturated (2E)-enoyl-CoA.

name: dolichyl-phosphate alpha-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + dolichyl phosphate = UDP + dolichyl N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl phosphate.

name: dopachrome isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-dopachrome = 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylate.

name: dolichol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + dolichol = CDP + dolichyl phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dolichyl phosphate D-mannose + protein = dolichyl phosphate + O-D-mannosylprotein.

name: dUTP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dUTP + H2O = dUMP + H+ + diphosphate.

name: obsolete deoxyhypusine synthase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: [eIF5A-precursor]-lysine + spermidine = [eIF5A-precursor]-deoxyhypusine + propane-1,3-diamine.

name: obsolete ecdysteroid UDP-glucosyl/UDP-glucuronosyl transferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: ecdysone O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: Ecdysone + palmitoyl-CoA = CoA + ecdysone palmitate.

name: electron-transferring-flavoprotein dehydrogenase activity
synonyms: electron transfer flavoprotein Q oxidoreductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a ubiquinone + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a ubiquinol + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain.

name: ATP-dependent peptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds, driven by ATP hydrolysis.

name: aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain.

name: obsolete leucyl aminopeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal amino acid, Xaa-Xbb-, in which Xaa is preferably Leu, but may be other amino acids including Pro although not Arg or Lys, and Xbb may be Pro.

name: obsolete membrane alanyl aminopeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal amino acid, Xaa-Xbb- from a peptide, amide or arylamide. Xaa is preferably Ala, but may be most amino acids including Pro (slow action). When a terminal hydrophobic residue is followed by a prolyl residue, the two may be released as an intact Xaa-Pro dipeptide.

name: carboxypeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single C-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain.

name: metallocarboxypeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single C-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which water acts as a nucleophile, one or two metal ions hold the water molecule in place, and charged amino acid side chains are ligands for the metal ions.

name: obsolete carboxypeptidase A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-L-amino acid + H2O = peptide + L-amino acid. Little or no action with -Asp, -Glu, -Arg, -Lys or -Pro.

name: obsolete carboxypeptidase E activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-L-lysine (or peptidyl-L-arginine) + H2O = peptide + L-lysine (or L-arginine). Function is activated by Co2+ and inhibited by 1,10-phenanthroline and other chelating agents.

name: obsolete lysine carboxypeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-L-lysine (or peptidyl-L-arginine) + H2O = peptide + L-lysine (or L-arginine). Release of a C-terminal basic amino acid, preferentially lysine; inactivates bradykinin and anaphylatoxins in blood plasma.

name: serine-type carboxypeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single C-terminal amino acid residue from the C-terminus of a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

name: obsolete carboxypeptidase C activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of a C-terminal amino acid with a broad specificity.

name: obsolete carboxypeptidase D activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential release of a C-terminal arginine or lysine residue. Function is inhibited by diisopropyl fluorophosphate and sensitive to thiol-blocking reagents.

name: obsolete serine-type Pro-X carboxypeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of a Pro-Xaa bond by a serine-type peptidase mechanism to release a C-terminal amino acid.

name: obsolete tubulinyl-Tyr carboxypeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of the Glu-Tyr bond to release the C-terminal tyrosine residue from the native tyrosinated tubulin. Inactive on Z-Glu-Tyr.

name: aspartic-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which a water molecule bound by the side chains of aspartic residues at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

name: obsolete barrierpepsin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the selected cleavage of the Leu6-Lys7 bond in the pheromone alpha-mating factor.

name: obsolete cathepsin D activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Specificity similar to, but narrower than, that of pepsin A. Does not cleave the Gln4-His5 bond in the B chain of insulin.

name: obsolete cathepsin E activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Similar to cathepsin D, but slightly broader specificity.

name: obsolete pepsin A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Preferential cleavage: hydrophobic, preferably aromatic, residues in P1 and P1' positions. Cleaves Phe1-Val2, Gln4-His5, Glu13-Ala14, Ala14-Leu15, Leu15-Tyr16, Tyr16-Leu17, Gly23-Phe24, Phe24-Phe25 and Phe25-Tyr26 bonds in the B chain of insulin.

name: obsolete renin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of Leu-Xaa bond in angiotensinogen to generate angiotensin I.

name: obsolete saccharopepsin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the degradation of gelatin; little activity on hemoglobin. Specificity on B chain of insulin more restricted than pepsin A; does not cleave Phe1-Val2, Gln4-His5 or Gly23-Phe24.

name: cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the sulfhydryl group of a cysteine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

name: calcium-dependent cysteine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism using a cysteine residue at the enzyme active center, and requiring the presence of calcium.

name: obsolete signaling (initiator) caspase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-1 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of interleukin 1-beta by specific cleavage of Asp116-Ala117 and Asp27-Gly28 bonds in precursor. Enzymes with this function can also hydrolyze the terminal bond in the small-molecule substrate, Ac-Tyr-Val-Ala-Asp-NHMec.

name: obsolete caspase-2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-4 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-5 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-8 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-10 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete effector caspase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-3 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage at the terminal bond of the motif: Asp-Xaa-Xaa-Asp-Xaa. Enzymes with this function are members of the peptidase family C14 and they appear to function in the inactivation of proteins involved in cellular repair and homeostasis during the effector stage of apoptosis.

name: obsolete caspase-6 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-7 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete caspase-9 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete lysosomal cysteine-type endopeptidase
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete cathepsin B activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds with a broad specificity. Preferentially cleaves the terminal bond of -Arg-Arg-Xaa motifs in small molecule substrates (thus differing from cathepsin L). In addition to being an endopeptidase, shows peptidyl-dipeptidase activity, liberating C-terminal dipeptides.

name: obsolete dipeptidyl-peptidase I activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal dipeptide, Xaa-Xbb from Xaa-Xbb-Xcc, except when Xaa is Arg or Lys, or Xbb or Xcc is Pro.

name: obsolete cathepsin H activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds, acting as an aminopeptidase (notably, cleaving Arg-Xaa bonds) as well as an endopeptidase.

name: obsolete cathepsin K activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Has a broad proteolytic activity. With small-molecule substrates and inhibitors, the major determinant of specificity is P2, which is preferably Leu, Met > Phe, and not Arg.

name: obsolete cathepsin L activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Specificity close to that of papain. As compared to cathepsin B, cathepsin L exhibits higher activity towards protein substrates, but has little activity on Z-Arg-Arg-NHMec, and no peptidyl-dipeptidase activity.

name: obsolete cathepsin S activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Similar to cathepsin L, but with much less activity on the terminal bond of Z-Phe-Arg-NHMec, and more activity on the terminal bond of Z-Val-Val-Arg-Xaa compounds.

name: obsolete pyroglutamyl-peptidase I activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: pyroglutamyl-peptide + H2O = pyroglutamate + peptide.

name: obsolete ubiquitin thiolesterase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ubiquitin C-terminal thioester + H2O = ubiquitin + a thiol.

name: metalloendopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which water acts as a nucleophile, one or two metal ions hold the water molecule in place, and charged amino acid side chains are ligands for the metal ions.

name: obsolete Gly-X carboxypeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-Gly-Xaa + H2O = peptidyl-Gly + Xaa.

name: obsolete gelatinase A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of gelatin type I and collagen types IV, V, VII, X. Cleaves the collagen-like sequence Pro-Gln-Gly-Ile-Ala-Gly-Gln at the Gly-Ile bond.

name: obsolete gelatinase B activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of gelatin types I and V and collagen types IV and V.

name: glutamyl aminopeptidase activity
synonyms: antigen BP-1/6C3 of mouse B lymphocytes
definition: Catalysis of the release of a N-terminal glutamate (and to a lesser extent aspartate) from a peptide.

name: obsolete insulysin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the degradation of insulin, glucagon and other polypeptides. No action on proteins.

name: obsolete interstitial collagenase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of one bond in native collagen. Cleavage of the triple helix of collagen at about three-quarters of the length of the molecule from the N-terminus, at Gly775-Ile776 in the alpha-1(I) chain. Cleaves synthetic substrates and alpha-macroglobulins at bonds where P1' is a hydrophobic residue.

name: obsolete macrophage elastase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of soluble and insoluble elastin. Specific cleavages are also produced at Ala14-Leu15 and Tyr16-Leu17 in the B chain of insulin.

name: obsolete matrilysin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of Ala14-Leu15 and Tyr16-Leu17 in B chain of insulin. No action on collagen types I, II, IV and V. Cleaves gelatin chain alpha-2(I) > alpha-1(I).

name: obsolete membrane dipeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of dipeptides.

name: obsolete meprin A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of protein and peptide substrates preferentially on carboxyl side of hydrophobic residues.

name: initiator methionyl aminopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the release of N-terminal initiator methionine from peptides.

name: obsolete mitochondrial processing peptidase activity
synonyms: processing enhancing peptidase (for one of two subunits)
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of N-terminal transit peptides from precursor proteins imported into the mitochondrion, typically with Arg in position P2.

name: obsolete alpha-mitochondrial processing peptidase
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete beta-mitochondrial processing peptidase
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete mitochondrial intermediate peptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal octapeptide as second stage of processing of some proteins imported in the mitochondrion.

name: obsolete mitochondrial inner membrane peptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the maturation of mitochondrial precursor proteins delivered to the intermembrane space.

name: obsolete neprilysin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage at the amino group of hydrophobic residues in insulin, casein, hemoglobin, and a number of other proteins and polypeptides.

name: obsolete peptidyl-dipeptidase A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of a C-terminal dipeptide, Xaa-Xbb from oligopeptide-Xaa-Xbb, when Xaa is not Pro, and Xbb is neither Asp nor Glu. Converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II.

name: obsolete saccharolysin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of Pro-Phe and Ala-Ala bonds.

name: obsolete stromelysin 1 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage where P1', P2' and P3' are hydrophobic residues.

name: obsolete stromelysin 3 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Was not defined before being made obsolete.

name: obsolete aminopeptidase I activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal amino acid, preferably a neutral or hydrophobic one, from a polypeptide. Aminoacyl-arylamides are poor substrates.

name: obsolete X-Pro dipeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of Xaa-Pro dipeptides; also acts on aminoacyl-hydroxyproline analogs. No action on Pro-Pro.

name: serine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

name: obsolete gamma-renin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of the Leu-Leu bond in synthetic tetradecapeptide renin substrate, producing angiotensin I, but not active on natural angiotensinogen. Also hydrolyzes BZ-Arg-para-nitroanilide.

name: obsolete acylaminoacyl-peptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: acylaminoacyl-peptide + H2O = acylamino acid + peptide.

name: obsolete vacuolar carboxypeptidase Y
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of a C-terminal amino acid with a broad specificity.

name: obsolete cathepsin G activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of peptide bonds. Specificity similar to chymotrypsin C.

name: obsolete cerevisin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of proteins with broad specificity, and of BZ-Arg-OET > Ac-Tyr-OET. Does not hydrolyze peptide amides.

name: obsolete chymotrypsin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Tyr-Xaa > Trp-Xaa > Phe-Xaa > Leu-Xaa.

name: obsolete dipeptidyl-peptidase IV activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal dipeptide, by the hydrolysis of the Xbb-Xcc bond in Xaa-Xbb-Xcc, preferentially when Xbb is Pro, provided Xcc is neither Pro nor hydroxyproline.

name: obsolete enteropeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the selective cleavage of Lys6-Ile7 bond in trypsinogen.

name: obsolete furin activity
synonyms: paired basic amino acid cleaving enzyme
paired basic amino acid converting enzyme
paired basic amino acid residue cleaving enzyme activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of mature proteins from their proproteins by cleavage of the terminal bond of Arg-Xaa-Yaa-Arg-Z motifs where Xaa can be any amino acid and Yaa is Arg or Lys. Releases albumin, complement component C3 and von Willebrand factor from their respective precursors.

name: obsolete granzyme A activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of proteins, including fibronectin, type IV collagen and nucleolin. Preferential cleavage: Arg-Xaa > Lys-Xaa > Phe-Xaa in small molecule substrates.

name: obsolete granzyme B activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Asp-Xaa > Asn-Xaa > Met-Xaa, Ser-Xaa.

name: obsolete pancreatic elastase II activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Leu-Xaa, Met-Xaa and Phe-Xaa. Hydrolyzes elastin.

name: obsolete plasmin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Lys-Xaa > Arg-Xaa; higher selectivity than trypsin. Converts fibrin into soluble products.

name: obsolete acrosin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Arg-Xaa > Lys-Xaa.

name: obsolete proprotein convertase 1 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of protein hormones, neuropeptides and renin from their precursors, generally by cleavage of -Lys-Arg-Xaa at the Arg-Xaa bond.

name: obsolete proprotein convertase 2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of protein hormones and neuropeptides from their precursors, generally by cleavage of -Lys-Arg-Xaa at the Arg-Xaa bond.

name: obsolete prolyl oligopeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of Pro-Xaa > Ala-Xaa in oligopeptides.

name: obsolete subtilase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Was not defined before being made obsolete.

name: obsolete kexin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage of the Arg-Xaa bond in Lys-Arg-Xaa and Arg-Arg-Xaa to process Yeast alpha-factor pheromone and killer toxin precursors.

name: obsolete subtilisin activity
synonyms: bacillus subtilis alkaline proteinase bioprase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the hydrolysis of proteins with broad specificity for peptide bonds, and a preference for a large uncharged residue in P1. Hydrolyzes peptide amides.

name: obsolete tissue kallikrein activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Arg-Xaa bonds in small molecule substrates. Highly selective action to release kallidin (lysyl-bradykinin) from kininogen involves hydrolysis of Met-Xaa or Leu-Xaa. The rat enzyme is unusual in liberating bradykinin directly from autologous kininogens by cleavage at two Arg-Xaa bonds.

name: obsolete tripeptidyl-peptidase II activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal tripeptide from a polypeptide at neutral pH.

name: obsolete trypsin activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the preferential cleavage of Arg-Xaa, Lys-Xaa.

name: threonine-type endopeptidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a mechanism in which the hydroxyl group of a threonine residue at the active center acts as a nucleophile.

name: obsolete proteasome endopeptidase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the cleavage at peptide bonds with very broad specificity.

name: enoyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 3-hydroxy-fatty acyl-CoA = a enoyl-CoA + H2O. This reaction usually occurs in the reverse direction, leading to the reduction of the double bound of enoyl-CoA in position 2 or 3. Specific reactions catalyzed include: a 4-saturated-(3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA = a (3E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O and a (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA = a (2E)-enoyl-CoA + H2O.

name: epoxide hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an epoxide + H2O = an ethanediol.

name: estradiol 17-beta-dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: estradiol-17-beta + NAD(P)+ = estrone + NAD(P)H + H+. The activity can use NAD+ or NADP+ as the acceptor.

name: estrone sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + estrone = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + estrone 3-sulfate.

name: ethanolamine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + ethanolamine = ADP + 2 H+ + phosphoethanolamine.

name: ethanolamine-phosphate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + ethanolamine phosphate = diphosphate + CDP-ethanolamine.

name: ethanolaminephosphotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CDP-ethanolamine + 1,2-diacylglycerol = CMP + a phosphatidylethanolamine.
