name: exo-alpha-sialidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-(2->3)-, alpha-(2->6)-, alpha-(2->8)-glycosidic linkages of terminal sialic residues in oligosaccharides, glycoproteins, glycolipids, colominic acid and synthetic substrates.

name: exopolyphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: polyphosphate(n) + H2O = polyphosphate(n-1) + phosphate.

name: obsolete farnesyl-diphosphate farnesyltransferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 2 farnesyl diphosphate = diphosphate + presqualene diphosphate.

name: geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: fatty acid synthase activity
synonyms: acyl-CoA:malonyl-CoA C-acyltransferase (decarboxylating, oxoacyl- and enoyl-reducing and thioester-hydrolysing)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + n malonyl-CoA + 2n NADPH + 2n H+ = long-chain fatty acid + n+1 CoA + n CO2 + 2n NADP+.

name: [acyl-carrier-protein] S-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + [acyl-carrier protein] = CoA + acetyl-[acyl-carrier protein].

name: [acyl-carrier-protein] S-malonyltransferase activity
synonyms: malonyl coenzyme A-acyl carrier protein transacylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: malonyl-CoA + [acyl-carrier protein] = CoA + malonyl-[acyl-carrier protein].

name: 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase activity
synonyms: acyl-malonyl acyl carrier protein-condensing enzyme activity
beta-ketoacyl acyl carrier protein synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + malonyl-[acyl-carrier protein] = 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + CO2 + [acyl-carrier protein].

name: 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH) activity
synonyms: beta-ketoacyl acyl carrier protein (ACP) reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + NADP+ = 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + NADPH + H+.

name: obsolete (3R)-3-hydroxypalmitoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] dehydratase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: (3R)-hydroxypalmitoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] = 2-hexadecenoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + H2O.

name: enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADH) activity
synonyms: NADH-enoyl acyl carrier protein reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2,3-saturated acyl-[ACP] + NAD+ = a (2E)-enoyl-[ACP] + H+ + NADH.

name: obsolete enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH, B-specific) activity
synonyms: reductase, enoyl-acyl carrier protein (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate)
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: acyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + NADP+ = trans-2,3-dehydroacyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + NADPH + H+.

name: obsolete oleoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] hydrolase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: (9Z)-octadecenoyl-[ACP] + H2O = (9Z)-octadecenoate + H+ + holo-[ACP].

name: fatty-acyl-CoA synthase activity
synonyms: acyl-CoA:malonyl-CoA C-acyltransferase (decarboxylating, oxoacyl- and enoyl- reducing)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + n malonyl-CoA + 2n NADH + 2n NADPH + 4n H+ = a long-chain acyl-CoA + n CoA + n CO2 + 2n NAD+ + 2n NADP+.

name: ferroxidase activity
synonyms: multicopper ferroxidase iron transport mediator activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 Fe2+ + 4 H+ + O2 = 4 Fe3+ + 2 H2O.

name: obsolete multicopper ferroxidase iron transport mediator activity
synonyms: multicopper ferroxidase iron transport mediator activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 4 Fe2+ + 4 H+ + O2 = 4 Fe3+ + 2 H2O.

name: ferredoxin-NADP+ reductase activity
synonyms: ferredoxin-nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate reductase activity
reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate-adrenodoxin reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NADP+ + H+ = 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + NADPH.

name: ferrochelatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: heme B (protoheme) + H+ = Fe(2+) + protoporphyrin IX.

name: tetrahydrofolylpolyglutamate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + tetrahydrofolyl-(Glu)(n) + L-glutamate = ADP + phosphate + tetrahydrofolyl-(Glu)(n+1).

name: obsolete formaldehyde dehydrogenase (glutathione) activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: formaldehyde + glutathione + NAD+ = S-formylglutathione + NADH + H+.

name: formamidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: formamide + H2O = formate + NH4.

name: formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + formate + tetrahydrofolate = ADP + phosphate + 10-formyltetrahydrofolate.

name: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate 2-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-fructose 2,6-bisphosphate + H2O = D-fructose-6-phosphate + phosphate.

name: fructose-bisphosphate aldolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: fumarate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate = fumarate + H2O.

name: fumarylacetoacetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4-fumarylacetoacetate + H2O = acetoacetate + fumarate + H+.

name: galactokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactose + ATP = alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: galactosylceramidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine + H2O = D-galactose + N-acylsphingosine.

name: (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2E)-geranyl diphosphate + isopentenyl diphosphate = (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + diphosphate.

name: glucan exo-1,3-beta-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the successive hydrolysis of beta-D-glucose units from the non-reducing ends of (1->3)-beta-D-glucans, releasing alpha-glucose.

name: glucan 1,4-alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues successively from non-reducing ends of the chains with release of beta-D-glucose.

name: glucokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-glucose = ADP + D-glucose-6-phosphate.

name: gluconolactonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucono-1,5-lactone + H2O = D-gluconate.

name: glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + NH4.

name: glucosamine 6-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + CoA + H+.

name: glucose dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose + acceptor = D-glucono-1,5-lactone + reduced acceptor.

name: glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-phosphate + NADP+ = D-glucono-1,5-lactone 6-phosphate + NADPH + H+.

name: glucose-6-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate + H2O = D-glucose + phosphate. D-glucopyranose is also known as D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: glucose-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: glucosylceramidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine + H2O = D-glucose + N-acylsphingosine.

name: glutamate 5-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + ATP = L-glutamyl 5-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: glutamate-5-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + NADP+ + phosphate = L-glutamyl 5-phosphate + H+ + NADPH.

name: glutamate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate = 4-aminobutanoate + CO2.

name: glutamate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + H2O + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + NH3 + NADH + H+.

name: glutamate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
synonyms: glutamate biosynthetic process, using glutamate dehydrogenase (NAD(P)+)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + H2O + NAD(P)+ = 2-oxoglutarate + NH3 + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + H2O + NADP+ = 2-oxoglutarate + NH3 + NADPH + H+.

name: glutamate synthase (NADPH) activity
synonyms: glutamate (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 L-glutamate + NADP+ = 2-oxoglutarate + L-glutamine + H+ + NADPH. This is a two-step reaction: (a) L-glutamate + NH3 = L-glutamine + H2O, (b) L-glutamate + NADP+ + H2O = NH3 + 2-oxoglutarate + NADPH + H+.

name: glutamine synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-glutamate + NH4+ = ADP + H+ + L-glutamine + phosphate.

name: glutamate-cysteine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteine + L-glutamate + ATP = L-gamma-glutamyl-L-cysteine + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: L-glutamate N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl-L-ornithine as donor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N2-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate = N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine.

name: glutaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamine + H2O = L-glutamate + NH4+.

name: glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate transaminase (isomerizing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + L-glutamine = D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + L-glutamate.

name: glutaryl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glutaryl-CoA + 2 H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + CO2 + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein].

name: glutathione-disulfide reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 glutathione + NADP+ = glutathione disulfide + NADPH + H+.

name: glutathione synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-gamma-glutamyl-L-cysteine + ATP + glycine = ADP + glutathione + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: glutathione transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: R-X + glutathione = H-X + R-S-glutathione. R may be an aliphatic, aromatic or heterocyclic group; X may be a sulfate, nitrile or halide group.

name: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) (phosphorylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + phosphate + NAD+ = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + NADH + H+.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an acyl-CoA + sn-glycerol 3-phosphate = a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + CoA.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + a quinone = glycerone phosphate + a quinol.

name: glycerol-3-phosphate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + O2 = glycerone phosphate + H2O2.

name: glycerol kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + glycerol = sn-glycerol 3-phosphate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: glycerone kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + glycerone = ADP + glycerone phosphate + 2 H+.

name: glycine hydroxymethyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + glycine + H2O = tetrahydrofolate + L-serine.

name: alpha-1,4-glucan glucosyltransferase (UDP-glucose donor) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n) + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = [(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl](n+1) + H+ + UDP.

name: obsolete glycine cleavage system
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reactions: glycine + lipoylprotein = S-aminomethyldihydrolipoylprotein + carbon dioxide (CO2), followed by S-aminomethyldihydrolipoylprotein + (6S)-tetrahydrofolate = dihydrolipoylprotein + (6R)-5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + ammonia. Made up of two components, aminomethyltransferase and glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating).

name: glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + glycine + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-aminomethyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[glycine-cleavage complex H protein] + CO2.

name: GPI mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichol-P-mannose to GlcN-acyl-PI bearing 0-3 mannoses during formation of the GPI precursor.

name: GDP-Man:Man(3)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + 2 GDP-alpha-D-mannose = an alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-[alpha-D-Man-(1->6)]-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + 2 GDP + 2 H+.

name: GDP-Man:Man(1)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP-alpha-D-mannose = an alpha-D-Man-(1->3)-beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP + H+.

name: glycylpeptide N-tetradecanoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: tetradecanoyl-CoA + glycyl-peptide = CoA + N-tetradecanoylglycyl-peptide.

name: glycoprotein-fucosylgalactoside alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine + glycoprotein-alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2)-D-galactose = UDP + glycoprotein-N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosaminyl-(1,3)-(alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2))-D-galactose.

name: fucosylgalactoside 3-alpha-galactosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + glycoprotein-alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2)-D-galactose = UDP + glycoprotein-alpha-D-galactosyl-(1,3)-(alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,2))-D-galactose.

name: GDP phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP + H2O = GMP + phosphate.

name: guanylate cyclase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP = 3',5'-cyclic GMP + diphosphate.

name: obsolete membrane-associated guanylate kinase
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GMP = ADP + GDP, associated with the cell membrane.

name: GMP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + GMP = ADP + GDP.

name: helicase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate, to drive the unwinding of a DNA or RNA helix.

name: heme oxygenase (decyclizing) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: heme b + 3 O2 + 3 reduced [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase] = biliverdin + CO + Fe2+ + H+ + 3 H2O + 3 oxidized [NADPH-hemoprotein reductase].

name: heparan sulfate 2-sulfotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate + heparan sulfate = adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + heparan sulfate 2-O-sulfate; results in 2-O-sulfation of iduronic acid residues in heparan sulfate.

name: obsolete hexaprenyldihydroxybenzoate methyltransferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + 3-hexaprenyl-4,5-dihydroxybenzoate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 3-hexaprenyl-4-hydroxy-5-methoxybenzoate.

name: hexokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-hexose = ADP + D-hexose 6-phosphate.

name: histidine ammonia-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidine = urocanate + NH3.

name: histidine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidine = histamine + CO2.

name: histidinol dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-histidinol + 2 NAD+ = 3 H+ + L-histidine + 2 NADH.

name: histidinol-phosphate transaminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidinol-phosphate + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + L-glutamate.

name: histidinol-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-histidinol phosphate + H2O = L-histidinol + phosphate.

name: histone acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysyl-[histone] + acetyl-CoA = N6-acetyl-L-lysyl-[histone] + CoA + H+.

name: histone deacetylase activity
definition: Removal of an acetyl group from a lysine residue in a histone.

name: holocytochrome-c synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: holocytochrome c = apocytochrome c + heme.

name: homoaconitate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (-)-homoisocitrate = cis-homoaconitate + H2O.

name: homocitrate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-oxoglutarate + acetyl-CoA + H2O = CoA + H+ + homocitrate.

name: homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: homogentisate + O2 = 4-maleylacetoacetate + H+.

name: homoserine dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homoserine + NADP+ = L-aspartate-4-semialdehyde + NADPH + H+.

name: homoserine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homoserine + ATP = O-phospho-L-homoserine + ADP + 2 H+.

name: homoserine O-acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-homoserine + acetyl-CoA = O-acetyl-L-homoserine + CoA.

name: hyalurononglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->4) linkages between N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosamine and D-glucuronate residues in hyaluronate.

name: hydroxyacylglutathione hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an S-(2-hydroxyacyl)glutathione + H2O = a 2-hydroxy carboxylate + glutathione + H+.

name: hydroxyethylthiazole kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methylthiazole + ATP = 4-methyl-5-(2-phosphoethyl)-thiazole + ADP + 2 H+.

name: hydroxymethylbilane synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + 4 porphobilinogen = hydroxymethylbilane + 4 NH4.

name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA = acetoacetate + acetyl-CoA.

name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + CoA + 2 NADP+ = (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + 2 H+ + 2 NADPH.

name: hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetoacetyl-CoA + acetyl-CoA + H2O = (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA + CoA + H+.

name: hypoxanthine phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: IMP + diphosphate = hypoxanthine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: iduronate-2-sulfatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the 2-sulfate groups of the L-iduronate 2-sulfate units of dermatan sulfate, heparan sulfate and heparin.

name: imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-erythro-1-(imidazol-4-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + H2O.

name: indole-3-glycerol-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(2-carboxyphenylamino)-1-deoxy-D-ribulose 5-phosphate = 1-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate + CO2 + H2O.

name: inorganic diphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: diphosphate + H2O = H+ + 2 phosphate.

name: obsolete inositol or phosphatidylinositol kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the phosphorylation of myo-inositol (1,2,3,5/4,6-cyclohexanehexol) or a phosphatidylinositol.

name: 1-phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + ATP = a 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: obsolete 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate kinase, class IA
definition: OBSOLETE. A class I PI3K activated by tyrosine phosphorylation events.

name: obsolete 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate kinase, class IB
definition: OBSOLETE. A class I PI3K activated via heterotrimeric G-proteins.

name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate phospholipase C activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-4,5-bisphosphate) + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol + H+.

name: phosphatidylinositol diacylglycerol-lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol = D-myo-inositol 1,2-cyclic phosphate + diacylglycerol.

name: obsolete inositol or phosphatidylinositol phosphatase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the removal of a phosphate group from phosphorylated myo-inositol (1,2,3,5/4,6-cyclohexanehexol) or a phosphatidylinositol.

name: phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate + H2O = 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol + phosphate.

name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bisphosphate + H2O = 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + phosphate.

name: inositol-1,4-bisphosphate 1-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1D-myo-inositol 1,4-bisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate + phosphate.

name: obsolete inositol-1,4,-bisphosphate 3-phosphatase
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: D-myo-inositol 1,3-bisphosphate + H2O = D-myo-inositol 1-monophosphate + phosphate.

name: obsolete inositol-1,4,-bisphosphate 4-phosphatase
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: D-myo-inositol 3,4-bisphosphate + H2O = D-myo-inositol 3-monophosphate + phosphate.

name: obsolete inositol-1,4,5-trisphosphate 1-phosphatase
definition: OBSOLETE. The removal of a phosphate group from the carbon-1 position of D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate.

name: inositol-polyphosphate 5-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol 1,4-bisphosphate + phosphate, and 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4,5-tetrakisphosphate + H2O = 1D-myo-inositol 1,3,4-trisphosphate + phosphate.

name: inositol hexakisphosphate phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: myo-inositol hexakisphosphate + H2O = myo-inositol pentakisphosphate + phosphate.

name: iodide peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: iodide + H2O2 = iodine + 2 H2O.

name: isocitrate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NAD(P)+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NAD(P)H.

name: isocitrate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
synonyms: nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide isocitrate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NAD+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADH.

name: isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
synonyms: isocitrate (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate + NADP+ = 2-oxoglutarate + CO2 + NADPH.

name: isocitrate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isocitrate = glyoxylate + succinate.

name: isopentenyl-diphosphate delta-isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: isopentenyl diphosphate = dimethylallyl diphosphate.

name: juvenile-hormone esterase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: methyl (2E,6E)-(10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6-dienoate + H2O = (2E,6E)-(10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6-dienoate + methanol. A carboxylesterase that hydrolyzes the ester linkage of juvenile hormone.

name: ketohexokinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + D-fructose = ADP + D-fructose 1-phosphate.

name: ketol-acid reductoisomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate + NADP+ = (S)-2-hydroxy-2-methyl-3-oxobutanoate + NADPH + H+.

name: phosphogluconate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-D-gluconate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: lactate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: lactate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + pyruvate.

name: D-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate.

name: L-lactate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + NAD+ = pyruvate + NADH + H+.

name: L-lactate dehydrogenase (cytochrome) activity
synonyms: cytochrome b2 (flavin-free derivative of flavocytochrome b2)
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-lactate + 2 [Fe(III)cytochrome c] = 2 [Fe(II)cytochrome c] + 2 H+ + pyruvate.

name: lactose synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-galactose + D-glucose = UDP + lactose.

name: lactoylglutathione lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-S-lactoylglutathione = glutathione + methylglyoxal.

name: leukotriene-A4 hydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + leukotriene A(4) = leukotriene B(4).

name: leukotriene-C4 synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: leukotriene C(4) = glutathione + leukotriene A(4).

name: lipoprotein lipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: triacylglycerol + H2O = diacylglycerol + a carboxylate, where the triacylglycerol is part of a lipoprotein. May also hydrolyze diacylglycerol and phospholipids present in lipoproteins.

name: long-chain fatty acyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain 2,3-saturated fatty acyl-CoA + H+ + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] = a long-chain (2E)-enoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

name: long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity
synonyms: long chain fatty acyl-CoA synthetase activity
long-chain fatty acyl coenzyme A synthetase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a long-chain fatty acid + ATP + CoA = a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate. A long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing 13 to 22 carbons.

name: L-lysine N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl phosphate as donor
synonyms: lysine N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl phosphate as donor
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl phosphate + L-lysine = phosphate + N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

name: malic enzyme activity
definition: Catalysis of the oxidative decarboxylation of malate with the concomitant production of pyruvate.

name: malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NAD+ = pyruvate + CO2 + NADH.

name: malate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-malate + NADP+ = pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH.

name: malate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + glyoxylate + H2O = (S)-malate + CoA + H+.

name: mannose-1-phosphate guanylyltransferase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate + GTP = diphosphate + GDP-alpha-D-mannose.

name: mannose-6-phosphate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-mannose 6-phosphate = D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + H2O = 10-formyltetrahydrofolate.

name: methionine adenosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + L-methionine + H2O = phosphate + diphosphate + S-adenosyl-L-methionine.

name: methionyl-tRNA formyltransferase activity
synonyms: conversion of mitochondrial met-tRNAf to fmet-tRNA
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + L-methionyl-tRNA + H2O = tetrahydrofolate + N-formylmethionyl-tRNA.

name: methylene-fatty-acyl-phospholipid synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phospholipid olefinic fatty acid = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + phospholipid methylene fatty acid.

name: mRNA 5'-cap (guanine-N7-)-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + G(5')pppR-RNA = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + m7G(5')pppR-RNA. m7G(5')pppR-RNA is mRNA containing an N7-methylguanine cap; R may be guanosine or adenosine.

name: methyltransferase cap1 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-ribonucleoside in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = a 5'-end (N(7)-methyl 5'-triphosphoguanosine)-(2'-O-methyl-ribonucleoside) in mRNA or snRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+. This activity catalyzes the methylation of the ribose on the first transcribed nucleotide of mRNAs and snRNAs.

name: mRNA guanylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + (5')pp-Pur-mRNA = diphosphate + G(5')ppp-Pur-mRNA; G(5')ppp-Pur-mRNA is mRNA containing a guanosine residue linked 5' through three phosphates to the 5' position of the terminal residue.

name: methylcrotonoyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-methylbut-2-enoyl-CoA + ATP + bicarbonate = trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: obsolete methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+] activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)+ = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NAD+ = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + NADH.

name: methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NADP+ = 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate + NADPH.

name: methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase [NAD(P)H] activity
synonyms: methylenetetrahydrofolate (reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) reductase activity
methylenetetrahydrofolate (reduced riboflavin adenine dinucleotide) reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-methyltetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)+ = 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate + NAD(P)H + H+.

name: methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA = trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA + H2O.

name: methylmalonate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (acylating, NAD) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoate + CoA + NAD+ = propanoyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH + H+. Can also use malonate (3-oxopropanoate) as a substrate. The reaction occurs in two steps with the decarboxylation process preceding CoA-binding. Bicarbonate rather than CO2 is released as a final product.

name: methyl/ethyl malonyl-CoA decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + H+ = CO2 + propanoyl-CoA or (2S)-ethylmalonyl-CoA + H+ = butanoyl-CoA + CO2.

name: methylmalonyl-CoA epimerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-methylmalonyl-CoA = (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-methylmalonyl-CoA = succinyl-CoA.

name: obsolete mevaldate reductase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + acceptor = mevaldate + reduced acceptor.

name: mevalonate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-mevalonate + ATP = (R)-5-phosphomevalonate + ADP + 2 H+.

name: monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the incorporation of one atom of molecular oxygen (O2) into the substrate and the reduction of the other atom of O2 to water.

name: calcidiol 1-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: calcidiol + H+ + NADPH + O2 = calcitriol + H2O + NADP+.

name: N,N-dimethylaniline monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N,N-dimethylaniline + NADPH + H+ + O2 = N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O.

name: dopamine beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ascorbate + dopamine + O2 = (R)-noradrenaline + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: ecdysone 20-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: AH(2) + ecdysone + O2 = 20-hydroxyecdysone + A + H2O.

name: kynurenine 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-kynurenine + H+ + NADPH + O2 = 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O + NADP+.

name: tyrosinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + O2 = L-DOPAquinone + H2O. This reaction can use both monophenols (such as tyrosine) and catechols (o-diphenols) as substrates.

name: peptidylglycine monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-glycine + ascorbate + O2 = peptidyl(2-hydroxyglycine) + dehydroascorbate + H2O.

name: phenylalanine 4-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = L-tyrosine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin.

name: squalene monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + NADPH + O2 + squalene = (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene + H2O + NADP+.

name: steroid 11-beta-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a steroid + reduced adrenal ferredoxin + O2 = an 11-beta-hydroxysteroid + oxidized adrenal ferredoxin + H2O.

name: steroid 17-alpha-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a C21-steroid + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = a 17alpha-hydroxy-C21-steroid + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase].

name: steroid 21-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: A C(21) steroid + [reduced NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = a 21-hydroxy-C(21)-steroid + [oxidized NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O.

name: tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O.

name: tyrosine 3-monooxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tyrosine + tetrahydrobiopterin + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxy-L-phenylalanine + 4-alpha-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin + H2O.

name: inositol-3-phosphate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-glucose 6-phosphate = 1D-myo-inositol 3-phosphate. This reaction requires NAD, which dehydrogenates the CHOH group to CO at C-5 of the glucose 6-phosphate, making C-6 into an active methylene, able to condense with the aldehyde at C-1. Finally, the enzyme-bound NADH reconverts C-5 into the CHOH form.

name: obsolete neolactotetraosylceramide alpha-2,3-sialyltransferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: CMP-N-acetylneuraminate + beta-D-galactosyl-1,4-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,3-beta-D-galactosyl-1,4-beta-D-glucosylceramide = CMP + alpha-N-acetylneuraminyl-2,3-beta-D-galactosyl-1,4-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosaminyl-1,3-beta-D-galactosyl-1,4-D-glucosylceramide.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide diphosphorylase (carboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CO2 + diphosphate + nicotinate D-ribonucleotide = 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + 2 H+ + quinolinate.

name: nicotinate-nucleotide adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ATP + H+ = deamido-NAD+ + diphosphate.

name: nicotinate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate + ATP + H2O = nicotinate beta-D-ribonucleotide + ADP + phosphate + diphosphate.

name: nitric-oxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + n NADPH + n H+ + m O2 = citrulline + nitric oxide + n NADP+.

name: nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids.

name: endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within nucleic acids by creating internal breaks.

name: DNA endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks.

name: RNA endonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within ribonucleic acid by creating internal breaks.

name: ribonuclease A activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 3'-phosphomononucleotides and 3'-phosphooligonucleotides ending in C-P or U-P with 2',3'-cyclic phosphate intermediates.

name: RNA-DNA hybrid ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA in RNA-DNA hybrids to 5'-phosphomonoesters.

name: ribonuclease III activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA with 5'-phosphomonoesters and 3'-OH termini; makes two staggered cuts in both strands of dsRNA, leaving a 3' overhang of 2 nt.

name: ribonuclease P activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of RNA, removing 5' extra nucleotides from tRNA precursor.

name: exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of ester linkages within nucleic acids by removing nucleotide residues from the 3' or 5' end.

name: phosphodiesterase I activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential hydrolytic removal of 5'-nucleotides from the 3'-hydroxy termini of 3'-hydroxy-terminated oligonucleotides.

name: DNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of a DNA molecule.

name: deoxyribonuclease I activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 5'-phosphodinucleotide and 5'-phosphooligonucleotide end products.

name: deoxyribonuclease II activity
definition: Catalysis of the endonucleolytic cleavage of DNA to 3'-phosphodinucleotide and 3'-phosphooligonucleotide end products.

name: RNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' or 3' terminus of an RNA molecule.

name: exoribonuclease H activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of RNA to 5'-phosphomonoester oligonucleotides in both 5' to 3' and 3' to 5' directions.

name: 5'-3' RNA exonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the sequential cleavage of mononucleotides from a free 5' terminus of an RNA molecule.

name: poly(A)-specific ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the exonucleolytic cleavage of poly(A) to 5'-AMP.

name: DNA nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid.

name: RNA nuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the cleavage of phosphodiester bonds in chains of RNA.

name: tRNA-specific ribonuclease activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of phosphodiester bonds in tRNA molecules.

name: nucleoside diphosphate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + nucleoside diphosphate = ADP + nucleoside triphosphate.

name: dinucleotide phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a dinucleotide + H2O = 2 mononucleotides.

name: octanol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-octanol + NAD+ = 1-octanal + H+ + NADH.

name: hydrolase activity, hydrolyzing O-glycosyl compounds
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any O-glycosyl bond.

name: alpha,alpha-trehalase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha,alpha-trehalose + H2O = 2 D-glucose.

name: alpha-amylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides containing three or more alpha-(1->4)-linked D-glucose units.

name: alpha-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-galactose residues in alpha-D-galactosides, including galactose oligosaccharides, galactomannans and galactolipids.

name: alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose.

name: alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-mannose residues in alpha-D-mannosides.

name: alpha-L-fucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = an alcohol + L-fucose.

name: alpha-N-acetylglucosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminides.

name: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-hexosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-hexosaminides.

name: beta-fructofuranosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + H2O = a non fructofuranosylated fructofuranosyl acceptor + a beta-D-fructofuranoside.

name: beta-galactosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-galactose residues in beta-D-galactosides.

name: beta-glucuronidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

name: beta-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-mannose residues in beta-D-mannosides.

name: chitinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) polymers of chitin and chitodextrins.

name: glycoprotein endo-alpha-1,2-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal alpha-glucosyl-(1,3)-mannosyl unit from Glc-Man(9)-(GlcNAc)(2) oligosaccharide component of the glycoprotein produced in the Golgi membrane.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,2-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal (1->2)-linked alpha-D-mannose residues in an oligo-mannose oligosaccharide.

name: mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,3-1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the terminal (1->3)- and (1->6)-linked alpha-D-mannose residues in the mannosyl-oligosaccharide Man(5)(GlcNAc)(3).

name: Glc3Man9GlcNAc2 oligosaccharide glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the exohydrolysis of the non-reducing terminal glucose residue in the mannosyl-oligosaccharide Glc(3)Man(9)GlcNAc(2).

name: oligo-1,6-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in some oligosaccharides produced from starch and glycogen by alpha-amylase, and in isomaltose. Releases a free alpha-D-glucose.

name: sucrose alpha-glucosidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: sucrose + H2O = alpha-D-glucose + beta-D-fructose.

name: oligosaccharyl transferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a oligosaccharyl group to an acceptor molecule, typically another carbohydrate or a lipid.

name: N-acetylglucosaminyldiphosphodolichol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-diphosphodolichol = UDP + N,N''-diacetylchitobiosyldiphosphodolichol.

name: chitobiosyldiphosphodolichol beta-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: an N,N'-diacetylchitobiosyl-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP-alpha-D-mannose = a beta-D-Man-(1->4)-beta-D-GlcNAc-(1->4)-alpha-D-GlcNAc-diphospho-di-trans,poly-cis-dolichol + GDP + H+.

name: dolichyl-diphosphooligosaccharide-protein glycotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide + protein L-asparagine = dolichyl diphosphate + a glycoprotein with the oligosaccharide chain attached by glycosylamine linkage to protein L-asparagine.

name: dolichyl-phosphate beta-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-glucose + dolichyl phosphate = UDP + dolichyl beta-D-glucosyl phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate beta-D-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GDP-mannose + dolichyl phosphate = GDP + dolichyl D-mannosyl phosphate.

name: dolichyl-phosphate-glucose-glycolipid alpha-glucosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-glucosyl residue from dolichyl-phosphate D-glucose into a membrane lipid-linked oligosaccharide.

name: obsolete dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-glycolipid alpha-mannosyltransferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the transfer of an alpha-D-mannosyl residue from dolichyl-phosphate D-mannose into membrane lipid-linked oligosaccharide.

name: ornithine carbamoyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: carbamoyl phosphate + L-ornithine = phosphate + L-citrulline.

name: ornithine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine + H+ = CO2 + putrescine.

name: ornithine aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxocarboxylate + L-ornithine = an L-alpha-amino acid + L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde.

name: orotate phosphoribosyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: orotidine 5'-phosphate + diphosphate = orotate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate.

name: dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (S)-dihydroorotate + NAD+ = H+ + NADH + orotate.

name: orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + orotidine 5'-phosphate = CO2 + UMP.

name: oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] + 2-oxoglutarate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-succinyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[dihydrolipoyllysine-residue succinyltransferase] + CO2.

name: pantoate-beta-alanine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine = AMP + diphosphate + (R)-pantothenate.

name: pantothenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-pantothenate + H2O = (R)-pantoate + beta-alanine.

name: pantothenate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pantothenate = ADP + D-4'-phosphopantothenate.

name: pantetheine-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + pantetheine 4'-phosphate = 3'-dephospho-CoA + diphosphate.

name: protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: acetyl-CoA + an N-terminal L-alpha-aminoacyl-[protein] = CoA + H+ + N-terminal Nalpha-acetyl-L-alpha-aminoacyl-[protein].

name: peptidylamidoglycolate lyase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidylamidoglycolate = peptidyl amide + glyoxylate.

name: obsolete cyclophilin
definition: OBSOLETE. A protein to which cyclosporin A (an immunosuppressant) binds. Possesses peptidyl-prolyl isomerase activity.

name: peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a donor + a peroxide = an oxidized donor + 2 H2O.

name: glutathione peroxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 glutathione + hydrogen peroxide = oxidized glutathione + 2 H2O.

name: phenylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phenylethanolamine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + N-methylphenylethanolamine.

name: phosphoadenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: adenosine 3',5'-diphosphate + H+ + sulfite + thioredoxin disulfide = 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate + thioredoxin. Thioredoxin disulfide is the oxidized form of thioredoxin; 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate is also known as PAPS.

name: phosphatidate cytidylyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + phosphatidate = diphosphate + CDP-diacylglycerol.

name: phosphatidylcholine-sterol O-acyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + a sterol = a sterol ester + 1-acylglycerophosphocholine.

name: phosphatidylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + phosphatidylethanolamine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H+ + phosphatidyl-N-methylethanolamine.

name: phosphatidylserine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H+ + phosphatidyl-L-serine = CO2 + phosphatidylethanolamine.

name: phosphoacetylglucosamine mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: phosphate + oxaloacetate = phosphoenolpyruvate + CO2 + other reaction products.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (ATP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + oxaloacetate = ADP + CO2 + H+ + phosphoenolpyruvate.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (GTP) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: GTP + oxaloacetate = GDP + phosphoenolpyruvate + CO2.

name: phosphoglucomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate = alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: phosphomannomutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: alpha-D-mannose 1-phosphate = D-mannose 6-phosphate.

name: phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 6-phospho-D-gluconate + NADP+ = D-ribulose 5-phosphate + CO2 + NADPH + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phosphoglycerate + NAD+ = 3-phosphohydroxypyruvate + NADH + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3-phospho-D-glycerate + ATP = 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl phosphate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphoglycerate mutase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (2R)-2-phosphoglycerate = (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate.

name: phospholipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a glycerophospholipid.

name: glycosylphosphatidylinositol phospholipase D activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: glycoprotein phosphatidylinositol + H2O = phosphatidate + glycoprotein inositol.

name: phosphatidylcholine lysophospholipase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + H2O = a fatty acid + H+ + sn-glycerol 3-phosphocholine.

name: phospholipase A2 activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospholipid + H2O = 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospholipid + a fatty acid. This reaction removes the fatty acid attached to the sn2-position. Substrates include phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine, choline plasmalogen and phosphatides.

name: obsolete secreted phospholipase A2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + H2O = 1-acylglycerophosphocholine + a fatty acid anion.

name: obsolete calcium-dependent secreted phospholipase A2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + H2O = 1-acylglycerophosphocholine + a fatty acid anion.

name: obsolete cytosolic phospholipase A2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + H2O = 1-acylglycerophosphocholine + a fatty acid anion.

name: obsolete calcium-dependent cytosolic phospholipase A2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + H2O = 1-acylglycerophosphocholine + a fatty acid anion.

name: obsolete calcium-independent cytosolic phospholipase A2 activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: phosphatidylcholine + H2O = 1-acylglycerophosphocholine + a fatty acid anion.

name: phospholipase C activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phospholipid + H2O = 1,2-diacylglycerol + a phosphatidate.

name: phospholipase D activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphatidylcholine + H2O = choline + a phosphatidate.

name: phosphomevalonate kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (R)-5-phosphomevalonate + ATP = (R)-5-diphosphomevalonate + ADP + H+.

name: phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: CTP + (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine = CMP + diphosphate + (R)-4'-phosphopantothenoyl-L-cysteine. Cysteine can be replaced by some of its derivatives.

name: phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-[(R)-4-phosphonatopantothenoyl]-L-cysteinate + H+ = CO2 + pantetheine 4'-phosphate.

name: phosphopyruvate hydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-phospho-D-glycerate = phosphoenolpyruvate + H2O.

name: phosphoribosyl-AMP cyclohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phosphonatoribosyl)-5'-AMP + H2O = 1-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-[(5-phosphoribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: phosphoribosyl-ATP diphosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP + H2O = 1-(5-phosphonatoribosyl)-5'-AMP + diphosphate + H+.

name: phosphoribosylamine-glycine ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-phospho-D-ribosylamine + ATP + glycine = N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazole carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate + 2 H+ = 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole + CO2.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazolesuccinocarboxamide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxylate + L-aspartate + ATP = (2S)-2-[5-amino-1-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamido]succinate + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylanthranilate isomerase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N-(5-phospho-beta-D-ribosyl)anthranilate = 1-(2-carboxyphenylamino)-1-deoxy-D-ribulose 5-phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine cyclo-ligase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2-(formamido)-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + ATP = 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-formyl-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = 2-(formamido)-N(1)-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)acetamidine + L-glutamate + ADP + 2 H+ + phosphate.

name: phosphoribosylaminoimidazolecarboxamide formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + 5'-phosphoribosyl-5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide = tetrahydrofolate + 5'-phosphoribosyl-5-formamido-4-imidazolecarboxamide.

name: phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 10-formyltetrahydrofolate + N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide = tetrahydrofolate + N2-formyl-N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide.

name: 1,4-alpha-oligoglucan phosphorylase activity
synonyms: muscle phosphorylase a and b activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n) + phosphate = 1,4-alpha-D-glucosyl(n-1) + alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate.

name: O-phospho-L-serine:2-oxoglutarate aminotransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: O-phospho-L-serine + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-phosphonooxypyruvate + L-glutamate.

name: poly(ADP-ribose) glycohydrolase activity
definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of poly(ADP-ribose) at glycosidic (1''-2') linkage of ribose-ribose bond to produce free ADP-ribose.

name: polygalacturonase activity
definition: Catalysis of the random hydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-galactosiduronic linkages in pectate and other galacturonans.

name: polynucleotide 5'-phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 5'-phosphopolynucleotide + H2O = a polynucleotide + phosphate.

name: obsolete polynucleotide adenylyltransferase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the template-independent extension of the 3'- end of an RNA or DNA strand by addition of one adenosine molecule at a time. Cannot initiate a chain 'de novo'. The primer, depending on the source of the enzyme, may be an RNA or DNA fragment, or oligo(A) bearing a 3'-OH terminal group.

name: polypeptide N-acetylgalactosaminyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine + polypeptide = UDP + N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-polypeptide. This reaction is the modification of serine or threonine residues in polypeptide chains by the transfer of a N-acetylgalactose from UDP-N-acetylgalactose to the hydroxyl group of the amino acid; it is the first step in O-glycan biosynthesis.

name: polyribonucleotide nucleotidyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: RNA(n+1) + phosphate = RNA(n) + a nucleoside diphosphate.

name: porphobilinogen synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 5-aminolevulinate = 2 H2O + H+ + porphobilinogen.

name: procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: procollagen L-proline + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = procollagen trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline + succinate + CO2.

name: proline dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + a quinone = (S)-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate + a quinol + H+.

name: propionyl-CoA carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + propanoyl-CoA + HCO3- = ADP + phosphate + (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: prenyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a prenyl group from one compound (donor) to another (acceptor).

name: protein farnesyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-cysteinyl-[protein] + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = S-(2E,6E)-farnesyl-L-cysteinyl-[protein] + diphosphate.

name: protein geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the covalent addition of a geranylgeranyl (20-carbon isoprenoid) group via thioether linkages to a cysteine residue at or near the C terminus of a protein.

name: CAAX-protein geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: geranylgeranyl diphosphate + protein-cysteine = S-geranylgeranyl-protein + diphosphate. This reaction is the formation of a thioether linkage between the C-1 atom of the geranylgeranyl group and a cysteine residue fourth from the C-terminus of the protein. The protein substrates have the C-terminal sequence CA1A2X, where the terminal residue, X, is preferably leucine and A2 should not be aromatic. Known substrates include most g-subunits of heterotrimeric G proteins and Ras-related GTPases such as members of the Ras and Rac/Rho families.

name: Rab geranylgeranyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 geranylgeranyl diphosphate + protein-cysteine = 2 S-geranylgeranyl-protein + 2 diphosphate. This reaction is the formation of two thioether linkages between the C-1 atom of the geranylgeranyl groups and two cysteine residues within the terminal sequence motifs XXCC, XCXC or CCXX. Known substrates include Ras-related GTPases of a single family and the Rab family.

name: prephenate dehydratase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prephenate = phenylpyruvate + H2O + CO2.

name: prephenate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
synonyms: prephenate (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate) dehydrogenase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: NADP+ + prephenate = (4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvate + CO2 + NADPH.

name: prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + AH2 + 2 O2 = A + H2O + prostaglandin H2.

name: prostaglandin-D synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: prostaglandin H(2) = prostaglandin D(2).

name: protein-arginine deiminase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: H2O + L-arginyl-[protein] = L-citrullyl-[protein] + NH4+, resulting in citrullination of the target protein. This reaction is calcium-dependent.

name: protein C-terminal S-isoprenylcysteine carboxyl O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein C-terminal S-farnesyl-L-cysteine methyl ester.

name: protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation of an amino acid residue in a protein, usually according to the reaction: a protein + ATP = a phosphoprotein + ADP.

name: protein histidine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-histidine = ADP + protein phospho-L-histidine.

name: protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: Phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: DNA-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: DNA dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: AMP-activated protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires the presence of AMP.

name: obsolete casein kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete casein kinase I activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: obsolete protein kinase CK2 activity
synonyms: protein kinase CK2, intrinsic catalyst activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: casein + ATP = phosphocasein + ADP.

name: calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity
synonyms: calcium- and calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity
Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase beta activity
calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase type II activity
multifunctional calcium- and calmodulin-regulated protein kinase activity
multifunctional calcium/calmodulin regulated protein kinase activity
definition: Calmodulin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + a protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate; and ATP + a protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate. This activity require the presence of calcium-bound calmodulin.

name: elongation factor-2 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [elongation factor 2] = ADP + [elongation factor 2] phosphate.

name: myosin light chain kinase activity
synonyms: calcium/calmodulin-dependent myosin light chain kinase activity
myosin light chain protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + myosin-light-chain = ADP + myosin-light-chain phosphate.

name: phosphorylase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 ATP + 2 phosphorylase b = 4 ADP + phosphorylase a.

name: cyclic nucleotide-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cNMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity
synonyms: cAMP-dependent protein kinase, intrinsic catalyst activity
definition: cAMP-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cGMP-dependent protein kinase activity
definition: cGMP dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein.

name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity
synonyms: cyclin-dependent protein kinase, intrinsic catalyst activity
definition: Cyclin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] = ADP + [eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2 alpha subunit] phosphate.

name: diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
synonyms: diacylglycerol-activated phospholipid-dependent protein kinase C activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction requires diacylglycerol.

name: calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Calcium-dependent catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated in the presence of diacylglycerol and calcium.

name: diacylglycerol-dependent, calcium-independent serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein = ADP + a phosphoprotein. This reaction is activated by diacylglycerol but not by calcium.

name: obsolete signal transducer, downstream of receptor, with serine/threonine kinase activity
synonyms: receptor signaling protein serine/threonine kinase activity
receptor signalling protein serine/threonine kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Conveys a signal from an upstream receptor or intracellular signal transducer by catalysis of the reaction: ATP protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

name: G protein-coupled receptor kinase activity
synonyms: G protein coupled receptor phosphorylating protein kinase activity
G-protein-coupled receptor phosphorylating protein kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + G protein-coupled receptor = ADP + G protein-coupled receptor phosphate.

name: obsolete NF-kappaB-inducing kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the phosphorylation of the alpha or beta subunit of the inhibitor of kappaB kinase complex (IKK).

name: JUN kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: JUN + ATP = JUN phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of members of the JUN family, a gene family that encodes nuclear transcription factors.

name: JUN kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: JNKK + ATP = JNKK phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation and activation of JUN kinase kinases (JNKKs).

name: MAP kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein + ATP = protein phosphate + ADP. This reaction is the phosphorylation of proteins. Mitogen-activated protein kinase; a family of protein kinases that perform a crucial step in relaying signals from the plasma membrane to the nucleus. They are activated by a wide range of proliferation- or differentiation-inducing signals; activation is strong with agonists such as polypeptide growth factors and tumor-promoting phorbol esters, but weak (in most cell backgrounds) by stress stimuli.

name: MAP kinase kinase activity
synonyms: MAP kinase or ERK kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the concomitant phosphorylation of threonine (T) and tyrosine (Y) residues in a T-X-Y motif in the activation loop of a MAP kinase (MAPK) substrate.

name: MAP kinase kinase kinase activity
synonyms: MLK-like mitogen-activated protein triple kinase activity
mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the phosphorylation and activation of a MAP kinase kinase; each MAP kinase kinase can be phosphorylated by any of several MAP kinase kinase kinases.

name: ribosomal protein S6 kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ribosomal protein S6 + ATP = ribosomal protein S6 phosphate + ATP.

name: protein serine/threonine/tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: ATP + a protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate; ATP + a protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate; and ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate.

name: protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein tyrosine = ADP + protein tyrosine phosphate.

name: transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal from one side of the membrane to the other to initiate a change in cell activity by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate.

name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + protein L-tyrosine = ADP + protein L-tyrosine phosphate by a non-membrane spanning protein.

name: obsolete signal transducer, downstream of receptor, with protein tyrosine kinase activity
synonyms: receptor signaling protein tyrosine kinase activity
receptor signalling protein tyrosine kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Conveys a signal from an upstream receptor or intracellular signal transducer by catalysis of the reaction: ATP + a protein-L-tyrosine = ADP + a protein-L-tyrosine phosphate.

name: obsolete focal adhesion kinase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. (Was not defined before being made obsolete).

name: protein-L-isoaspartate (D-aspartate) O-methyltransferase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: S-adenosyl-L-methionine + protein L-beta-aspartate = S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + protein L-beta-aspartate methyl ester.

name: protein-lysine 6-oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: peptidyl-L-lysyl-peptide + H2O + O2 = peptidyl-allysyl-peptide + NH3 + hydrogen peroxide.

name: phosphoprotein phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphoprotein + H2O = a protein + phosphate. Together with protein kinases, these enzymes control the state of phosphorylation of cellular proteins and thereby provide an important mechanism for regulating cellular activity.

name: protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate, and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate.

name: calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity
synonyms: calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine phosphatase, intrinsic catalyst activity
definition: Catalysis of the reactions: protein serine phosphate + H2O = protein serine + phosphate; and protein threonine phosphate + H2O = protein threonine + phosphate. These reactions require the presence of calcium ions.

name: protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: obsolete prenylated protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the reaction: prenylated-protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = prenylated-protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: obsolete signal transducer, downstream of receptor, with protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
synonyms: receptor signaling protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
receptor signalling protein tyrosine phosphatase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Conveys a signal from an upstream receptor or intracellular signal transducer by catalysis of the reaction: protein tyrosine phosphate + H2O = protein tyrosine + phosphate.

name: oxygen-dependent protoporphyrinogen oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: 3 O2 + protoporphyrinogen IX = 3 H2O2 + protoporphyrin IX.

name: pseudouridylate synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: D-ribose 5-phosphate + uracil = H2O + pseudouridine 5'-phosphate.

name: purine-nucleoside phosphorylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: purine nucleoside + phosphate = purine + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.

name: pyridoxal oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction:  pyridoxal + H2O + O2 = 4-pyridoxate + H+ + H2O2.

name: pyridoxamine phosphate oxidase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate + H2O + O2 = pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + NH4+ + hydrogen peroxide. This activity can also oxidize pyridoxine 5'-phosphate to pyridoxal 5'-phosphate + hydrogen peroxide.

name: pyrimidodiazepine synthase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a pyrimidodiazepine + oxidized glutathione = 6-pyruvoyltetrahydropterin + 2 glutathione.

name: pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: L-proline + NADP+ = 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate + NADPH + H+.

name: pyruvate carboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP + bicarbonate + pyruvate = ADP + 2 H+ + oxaloacetate + phosphate.

name: pyruvate decarboxylase activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: a 2-oxo acid = an aldehyde + CO2.

name: obsolete pyruvate dehydrogenase activity
definition: OBSOLETE. Catalysis of the oxidative decarboxylation of pyruvate.

name: pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity
definition: Catalysis of the reaction: N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + pyruvate + H+ = N(6)-[(R)-S(8)-acetyldihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[protein] + CO2.
